capabilities: Render Bases notes as graph nodes
Draw links from note links or connector-note relations
Style nodes, links and groups with cascading rule tables
Switch force, frozen and tree layouts
Group, collapse and preview notes by property
extras: No network requests; rule tables are stored in .base files; filter conditions rely on the internal Bases API with a simplified fallback evaluator; beta builds install via BRAT.
intentEvidence: A graph view for Obsidian Bases.
problem: The core graph view cannot show a Bases collection with typed relations between notes, property-driven styling, grouping and layout control.

relations.evidence: A graph view for Obsidian Bases.

summary: Graph view for Obsidian Bases rendering base notes as nodes with rule-table links, connector-note relations, groups and force, frozen and tree layouts.
